context: Tests whether the agent restructures a wandering strategy section to lead with the decision and to state at least one explicit no.

checklist.name: Leads with the decision
checklist.description: The first sentence or two state the decision: fund a six-person platform team in Q1 owning a single CI and deploy path.

checklist.name: Names something it says no to
checklist.description: The rewrite explicitly states at least one thing the strategy rejects, such as buying a vendor product, letting each team standardize on its own, or forcing language and framework choices.

checklist.name: Background is cut down
checklist.description: History about growth and the earlier reasonableness of the choices is shortened to what supports the decision, not kept as a lead-in.

checklist.name: Keeps the facts
checklist.description: Key figures remain: 40 to 310 engineers, six CI systems, four ways to deploy, about 30 percent of the week, six-person team, Q1 start, end of Q4 target.

checklist.name: Strategist's voice
checklist.description: The text reads as direct statements by a decision maker, with no hedging phrases such as 'a number of options' or 'after a lot of discussion', and no emoji.
